describe.description: The creature is shown in right-facing side profile against a plain off-white background, standing low to the ground on four short limbs. It has a pale pink, fleshy axolotl-like head, underbelly, and legs with wrinkled skin, and a continuous covering of large, overlapping dark brown to grayish scales with lighter tan edges over its back, sides, and long tail. The head is broad and rounded with large dark eyes, small nostrils, and a slightly upturned mouth, with dark speckling on the dorsal surface. Six pink, feathery external gill stalks with fine filaments protrude from the sides of the neck just behind the head. The body is elongated and robust, the tail is long, thick at the base and tapering toward the left edge of the image, scaled on top and pale and ridged underneath. The four limbs are stout and end in clawed, five-toed feet.

describe.description: A low-slung quadrupedal creature shown in right-facing profile with a broad, pale pink head with a blunt snout, dark round eyes, and dark speckling on top. Behind the head protrude multiple pink stalks with fine feathery filaments. The body is stout with a pale pink wrinkled underbelly and four short thick pink limbs ending in small clawed toes. The entire dorsal surface from behind the head to the tip of the long tapering tail is covered in large overlapping rounded brown-gray scales. The tail extends to the left and is scaly on top and pale underneath.
